GreatWork.title: The Great Work
GreatWork.overviewDescription: The Great Work (Magnum Opus) is the alchemical process of transforming base matter into gold. In alchemy, this path symbolizes the transformation of the self: a passage from ignorance to knowledge, from fragmentation to unity. Its four stages — Nigredo, Albedo, Citrinitas, and Rubedo — trace a journey of death and rebirth, purification, illumination, and integration.
GreatWork.overviewReading: In reading, these stages reflect an inner path of learning: letting go of old ideas, clarifying understanding, discovering new perspectives, and finally putting knowledge into practice and living it more fully.

NIGREDO.name: Nigredo
NIGREDO.subtitle: Possibility
NIGREDO.description: The book is still waiting to be encountered.
NIGREDO.alchemy: Matter breaks down so transformation can begin.
NIGREDO.journeyDescription: This is the encounter with the shadow. What once seemed solid dissolves, old structures break apart, and certainties are questioned. It is fertile chaos that makes room for something new.

ALBEDO.name: Albedo
ALBEDO.subtitle: Reading in progress
ALBEDO.description: Passages and impressions begin to take shape.
ALBEDO.alchemy: Matter is purified and begins to gain clarity.
ALBEDO.journeyDescription: What was confused grows still. The mind becomes clearer, the senses more refined, and new ways of understanding emerge. This is a time to put things in order and build a solid foundation.

CITRINITAS.name: Citrinitas
CITRINITAS.subtitle: Post-reading reflection
CITRINITAS.description: The reading is finished; what remained can be gathered.
CITRINITAS.alchemy: Light reveals an understanding that was taking shape.
CITRINITAS.journeyDescription: Knowledge matures and comes alive. New connections appear, ideas come together, and deeper understanding emerges. This is a time to see more clearly, connect what you know, and apply what you have learned.

RUBEDO.name: Rubedo
RUBEDO.subtitle: Assimilated work
RUBEDO.description: What was read becomes part of your repertoire.
RUBEDO.alchemy: The transformed parts unite and the work is complete.
RUBEDO.journeyDescription: This is integration. Everything dissolved, purified, and illuminated takes on a new, fuller form. Knowledge finds expression in practice and becomes part of life.
